name: The Essence of Aku'Mai
summary: At Zoram'gar Outpost, Je'neu Sancrea asks Horde adventurers to stop the naga's sapphire harvest in Blackfathom Deeps. He fears they will misuse the gems' power.

sections.title: A Threat in the Depths
sections.body: From the Zoram Strand, Je'neu Sancrea watches over the Kaldorei ruins. Naga now mine sapphire clusters in the submerged chambers of Blackfathom Deeps, where the gems grow along damp cavern walls. Sancrea senses the serpentine invaders mean to harness their power, so he seeks to stop the harvest before they can use it.

sections.title: Water Spirits and Arcane Power
sections.body: The Sapphires of Aku'mai carry elemental water energy and hold clinging water spirits. Adept sorcerers could fuel dangerous arcane rituals with them or strengthen Aku'mai, the shadowy hydra whose presence fills the subterranean temple. Recovering the clusters keeps this potent reagent from the naga and helps guard the coastline against unchecked elemental magic.

faq.answer: At Zoram'gar Outpost on the Zoram Strand in north-western Ashenvale, Je'neu Sancrea, a Darkspear troll shaman, makes the request.

faq.q: Why do the naga want the Sapphires of Aku'Mai?
faq.answer: The naga's exact purpose is unknown. The sapphires hold potent elemental water energy and raw magical power that could fuel their spells.

faq.q: Where are the sapphire clusters found?
faq.answer: Sapphire clusters line the cavern walls and floors in Blackfathom Deeps' outer tunnels and flooded passages. They lie just inside the ruined underground entrance along the Zoram Strand.
Aku'mai is a monstrous three-headed hydra dwelling deep within the submerged temple ruins. Twilight's Hammer cultists revere him as a servant of the Old Gods.

faq.q: Do I have to kill any dungeon bosses for this quest?
aliases: do i need a full group
faq.answer: No. The sapphire clusters grow in the earlier submerged tunnels, before you encounter Blackfathom Deeps' main bosses.

faq.q: Does this quest connect to any other storyline?
faq.answer: Yes. It follows 'Trouble in the Deeps' and continues Je'neu Sancrea's investigation into the rising darkness and cultist activity in Blackfathom Deeps.

angles.text: As a shaman, you can sense the restless water spirits bound within the crystals. They warn of corrupted elemental forces beneath the temple.
As a member of the Horde, you help guard the perilous foothold at Zoram'gar Outpost. Keeping nearby naga from gaining raw magical power helps defend it.
As a troll, you can look to Je'neu Sancrea, an observant Darkspear mystic. He relies on communion with the spirits and ancestral wisdom to face Kalimdor's strange threats.
